create trigger trg_tbl_menu_categories_lcm
on dbo.tbl_menu_categories
after update
as
begin
    set nocount on;

    update t
    set lcm = getdate()
    from dbo.tbl_menu_categories t
    inner join inserted i
        on t.menu_category_id = i.menu_category_id;
end;
